scientific_integrity: Two separately implemented exhaustive transition/cycle-count programs and independent complete basin and square-circulation checks; no stochastic extrapolation or external audit claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite-dimension exhaustive theorem only (dimensions 1 through 4); the recurrence classification is not claimed for higher-dimensional hypercubes. The first-public date identifies a motivating prior paper, not a publication date for this finding. Historical priority against unindexed finite census tables is not independently established.
title: Primitive excitation periods on the four-cube: an exact finite-state census
